title: The flux density satisfies the rotation (α) and dilation (β) test identities
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) a cone (IsConeCurrent C), R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep univ 2 representing C, μ := R.measure, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with orthogonal projection π, a, e ∈ ℝ^P, 0 < s ≤ 1/4 and H : ℝ² → ℝ. Let T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x with projection p_{T_x}, Ax := ⟨x,a⟩e − ⟨x,e⟩a, G(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|²/|πx|², f(x) := arctan(⟨x,e⟩/⟨x,a⟩) and Z := {x : ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s, |f(x)| < s, |x − πx| < s|x|}. Assume (TS) for every r > 0, T_{rx} = T_x for μ-a.e. x; (SI) for every Borel b : ℝ² → ℝ with sup|b| < ∞, ∫ b(p)H(p) dp = ∫_Z b(|x|, f(x))G(x) dμ(x); (RC) for all C¹ functions ψ, l : ℝ → ℝ with tsupport ψ ⊆ (−s, s) and tsupport l ⊆ (1 − s, 1 + s), ∫_Z ψ'(f(x))l(|x|)G(x) dμ(x) = 0. Then (α) for all C¹ ψ, l with tsupport ψ ⊆ (−s, s) and tsupport l ⊆ (1 − s, 1 + s), ∫ ψ'(p_2)l(p_1)H(p) dp = 0; and (β) for all C¹ l, ψ with tsupport l ⊆ (1 − s/2, 1 + s/2), tsupport ψ ⊆ (−s, s) and every r ∈ ℝ with |r − 1| < s/4, ∫ l(p_1/r)ψ(p_2)H(p) dp = r² ∫ l(p_1)ψ(p_2)H(p) dp.
